name: unbounded_imasm_factorization_membrane_v5

surface_tokens: N (target integer as IMASM numeral tape)
phase_0.boundary_condition: The membrane closes when the coupled trace reaches k=m and W_t equals the number of verified factor pairs

⊢.justification: Initial void before N and trace are initialized

⊣.justification: Terminal anchor when k=m and all factors enumerated

≻.justification: Forward progression through trace steps k=0 to k=m

≺.justification: Reverse when W_t exceeds solution bound

⋈.justification: Chain step k to step k+1 in the coupled trace

⊙.justification: The trace state at step k is its own canonical representation

∈.chosen_element: fork trace into residue and interval lanes
∈.justification: Trace state splits into two parallel computation lanes: low-k-bit residue enumeration and high-l-bit interval enumeration

∋.chosen_element: join lanes back to trace state
∋.justification: Both lanes return to the same trace state; FFUSE rejoins them — the trace state enters and exits unchanged, only W_t is updated

⊥.justification: Deposit F when tuple fails bridge

⊞.justification: Hold both T and F when one lane extends and the other doesn't

⊡.justification: Permanent record of (p,q) where p*q=N verified by tape multiplication

phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.true_description: Trace state with W_t > 0 (extendable pairs exist)
phase_3.false_description: Trace state with W_t = 0 (no extendable pairs)
phase_3.both_description: Trace state with partial extension (one lane has pairs, other doesn't)

steps.domain_action: load N as IMASM numeral tape
fork trace into residue and interval lanes
residue lane enumerates k-bit odd tapes (pl,ql)
deposit T for each congruent pair
interval lane enumerates l-bit top tapes (ph,qh)
deposit T for each overlapping pair
record verified factor pairs from W_t

phase_5.memory_mechanism: PhaseObservationFrame banks deposits across AREV clears
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: coupled trace iterates k=0 to m, parallel lane enumeration
phase_5.alfs_store: divisor_membrane.rs implements membrane; morphism_factor.rs provides tape arithmetic

phase_6.cycle_cost: tape enumeration O(2^(2k+2l)) per step, bridge evaluation O(W_t)
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: trace state at step k with W_k pairs
phase_6.post_cycle_state: trace state at step k+1 with W_{k+1} pairs
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS≈0 — trace state preserved through FSPLIT/FFUSE; AREV backtracks reversibly; deposits are information, not entropy
